records.name: Philadelphia Council for Community Advancement
records.notes: Housing counseling agency that works one on one with home buyers and homeowners facing foreclosure. It is a service, not a group people join, attend or volunteer with. The page gives no way to book, no phone, email or address, and no events or volunteer roles. Every dated item on the site is from January 2022, so status is dormant. Hidden as having no public way in. Revisit only if it starts running open community programs.

records.name: CPCU Society Philadelphia Chapter
records.summary: The local chapter of the CPCU Society, a group for insurance professionals. Members meet, take Society courses, and go to chapter events such as an October industry discussion.
records.what_you_do: Go to chapter meetings and events, take part in Society education and mentoring, and sign up for the October 22 View From the Top discussion of property and casualty insurance trends.

schedule.text: Chapter meetings and events through the year. The next listed event is View From the Top 2026 on October 22, 2026.

cost.text: Dues are not stated on the chapter site.

first_step.how: Join the CPCU Society through the Join Today link on the chapter site, then register for View From the Top 2026 on October 22.
first_step.basis: Membership and dues come first, and the page does not say whether events are open to guests.

records.notes: IRS title is 'Philadelphia Cpcu Society Chapter'. The chapter site says it is in preview mode, so it may not be fully live. Meeting place and open-meeting rules are on a chapter page that was not read, so no location is recorded. Kind set to network as a professional association. Membership is in the Society, not the chapter alone.

records.name: Philadelphia Home and School Council
records.summary: A parent and caregiver advocacy group for Philadelphia public schools. It helps families start and run Home and School Associations and holds workshops to train parent advocates.
records.what_you_do: Parents take part through their child's school Home and School Association, and the council's workshops help families speak up for their children's schooling.

first_step.how: Ask your child's school whether it has a Home and School Association, and go to its next meeting or election.
first_step.basis: Parents join through their own school's association. No public meeting schedule or contact for the council itself was found, so the way in is unclear.

records.notes: The batch website was a name, not a web address, so it was treated as missing. The one search found no website for the council itself. The sign of life is a City Council page (phlcouncil.com) honoring the council's 125th anniversary, showing September 26, 2025, which may be the posting date rather than the resolution date. IRS legal name is 'Philadelphia Home & School Council Administration Building'; the address is the School District administration building at 440 N Broad St. A 2015 school letter seen only in search results says the council holds monthly sessions for association leaders on the first Tuesday at the School District; that letter was not read in full. Not the same body as the School District's Parent and Community Advisory Council.

records.name: Philadelphia Mobile Food Association
records.notes: IRS 990-N filer at PO Box 2014 (19103). The batch website returns a TLS certificate error on two attempts (unable to get a local issuer certificate), so no page could be read. If it turns out to be a trade association with no public program, change to hide out_of_scope.

records.name: Philadelphia Science Fiction Society
records.summary: A society for science fiction and fantasy fans in Philadelphia. It holds free meetings most months with guest speakers, author talks and fan panels.
records.what_you_do: Come to meetings, most of them free and some online, to hear guest speakers and authors and join fan panels. The November meeting is held in person at PHILCON.

schedule.text: Most months on a Friday evening, usually 8 pm, alternating between online (Zoom) and in person. No August meeting is listed. The page gives month and day without a year.

locations.label: St. Mary's at Penn (in person meetings)

cost.text: Meetings are free and open to the public.

first_step.how: Come to the next Friday meeting, online or at St. Mary's at Penn, then email info@psfs.org to ask how to join the announcement list.
first_step.basis: Meetings are free and open to the public with a listed contact, though the page does not say how guests are treated.

records.notes: Status is probably_active, not active: the meeting list shows month and day with weekdays that fit 2026, but no year is written next to them. The 2026 in the footer does not count. St. Mary's at Penn appears as both 3916 Locust Street and 3916 Locust Walk on the page; Locust Walk is used because it appears in the meeting-location paragraph. Membership exists, but dues and guest rules were not on the pages read. The society says its first meeting was in 1936.

records.name: Philadelphia-Israel Chamber of Commerce
records.notes: A business membership chamber that connects Israeli start-up companies with regional partners and markets. Membership is by company tier, and no community program open to the public was found. The events page is listed, but the pages read show no dated items and do not say whether non-members can attend. Hidden as a business association with no community program. Address on the site: 100 E Penn Square, Philadelphia, PA 19107. Revisit if it runs open public events or volunteer programs.

records.name: Jewelers' Row District
records.notes: District organization for stores and restaurants between Walnut and Market Streets and 7th and 9th Streets, run as a member association. Its public events (happy hours and a Diamonds and Dogs event) are undated on the page, and no volunteer, class or resident program was found. Hidden as a business association with no community program. IRS legal name is 'Philadelphia Jewelers Row Associa Tion'. The phone number on the page belongs to a member business and was not recorded.

records.name: Philadelphia Music Alliance
records.notes: Nonprofit that keeps up the Walk of Fame on the Avenue of the Arts, runs school-based programs for high school music students (career summits, masterclasses, scholarships, and an instrument donation with Musicopia), and lists a mailing address in Bala Cynwyd. No public way for an adult to join, volunteer or take a class was found, and the pages read have no dated items. Hidden for now. Revisit if it posts volunteer roles, open classes or public events.

records.name: Philadelphia Public School Notebook
records.notes: Nonprofit education news outlet. No volunteer, class or membership program was found. The site address redirects to Chalkbeat Philadelphia (philadelphia.chalkbeat.org, then www.chalkbeat.org/philadelphia/), and that page does not mention The Notebook, so a merger is not confirmed. If a merger is confirmed, change the verdict to duplicate or defunct. Hidden as a news outlet with no community program.

records.name: Philadelphia Railroad and Steam Works Museum
records.notes: Railroad and steam history museum (site title 'Philly Steams'). Its pages ask for donations of items and money and say it is a 501(c)(3). They list no open hours, admission, volunteer calls, classes or membership, and no phone, email or street address. The newest dated post is January 29, 2022, so status is dormant. Hidden as having no public way in. IRS legal name is 'Philadelphia Railroad and Steam Works Museum Inc'.
